uses: Combine a scanned passport, ID and application form into one PDF for an online application.
Join monthly invoices or bank statements into a single file for your accountant.
Put together chapters, a cover page and an appendix into one report or thesis.
Merge several signed pages back into the full contract.

If the final file is too large for email, run it through Compress PDF afterwards.

compress.title: Compress PDF – Reduce PDF File Size Online Free | {brand}

uses: Make a scanned PDF small enough for an online form with a 1 MB or 2 MB limit.
Send a large report by email or WhatsApp.
Save storage space on your phone or cloud drive.
tips: Try Lossless first – it keeps text selectable. Use Strong for scanned or photo-heavy files.
For text-based PDFs that are already small, large savings may not be possible.
Compress after merging, not before, to get one optimised file.

faq.q: How much smaller will my PDF be?
faq.a: It depends on the content. Scanned and image-heavy PDFs often shrink by 50–90% in Strong mode; text-only PDFs shrink less.

faq.q: Can I compress a PDF to under 1 MB or 100 KB?
faq.a: Often yes for scans using Strong mode. Very long documents may still be larger; splitting them can help.

split.title: Split PDF – Extract Pages or Split by Range Online Free | {brand}
split.desc: Split a PDF into single pages or custom ranges like 1-3,5. Free, unlimited and private – your PDF is split in your browser and never uploaded.

guide.intro: Splitting lets you pull out just the pages you need – one chapter, one invoice, one signed page – instead of sending a whole document. With {brand} the split happens locally, so large or sensitive PDFs stay on your device.
uses: Send only the relevant pages of a long contract or report.
Break a scanned bundle of receipts into one file per page.
Separate chapters of an e-book or study material.
tips: Use ranges like 1-3,7,10-12 to create several files at once.
Leave the field empty to split every page into its own PDF.
Want one file with chosen pages only? Use Extract pages instead.

faq.q: Will the split pages keep links and quality?
faq.a: Yes. Pages are copied without re-rendering, so text, images and quality are unchanged.

pdf2word.title: PDF to Word Converter – Convert PDF to DOCX Free | {brand}
pdf2word.desc: Convert PDF to an editable Word (DOCX) file for free. No sign-up, no limits, and your document is converted in your browser, never uploaded.

uses: Reuse text from an old report or letter without retyping.
Edit a document when you no longer have the original Word file.
Copy paragraphs into a new document or presentation.

Scanned PDF? Built-in OCR (Auto mode) reads pages that have no text layer.

uses: Turn phone photos of documents into one PDF for an application.
Combine receipts into a PDF for expense claims.
Send homework or handwritten notes as a single file.
tips: Choose A4 or Letter page size for documents that will be printed.
Rotate or crop photos first with the image tools for a neater result.
If the PDF is too big, use Compress PDF afterwards.

guide.intro: Converting PDF pages to images makes them easy to share on social media, insert into slides or view on any device. {brand} renders each page in your browser at the resolution you choose.
uses: Share a single page of a PDF on WhatsApp or Instagram.
Insert PDF pages into PowerPoint or Google Slides.
Create thumbnails or previews of a document.
tips: Choose PNG for sharp text and diagrams, JPG for smaller photo pages.
Use 2x or 3x resolution if the images will be printed or zoomed.

uses: Turn your CV or cover letter into a PDF before applying for jobs.
Send letters or reports that must not be edited.
Prepare documents for printing.
tips: This beta keeps text, headings, bold, italic and lists; check documents with images or complex layout.
For full-fidelity layout, Word's own Save as PDF is also an option.

guide.intro: Need to fill in a field, fix a typo or add a note to a PDF? {brand} lets you add text and white-out boxes on any page without installing software or uploading your file.
uses: Fill in a simple form that has no fillable fields.
Cover a mistake with white-out and type the correct text.
Add a date, name or note to a document.
tips: Zoom the preview to place text precisely.
To hide sensitive information permanently, use Redact PDF instead of white-out.

guide.intro: Sign documents in under a minute without printing and scanning. Draw your signature with a finger, mouse or stylus, or type it, and place it anywhere on the page – all on your device.

Add initials to every page of a contract.

Share ID documents with a password sent separately.
Protect business proposals and contracts.

Share the password through a different channel than the file.

uses: Remove the password from bank or credit-card statements you own.
Prepare protected PDFs for merging or compressing.

Prepare court bundles or contract exhibits that must be referenced by page.
Add numbers to a merged report so readers can follow the table of contents.
Number printed handouts so loose pages can be put back in order.

uses: Remove blank pages left by a double-sided scanner.
Drop advert or cover pages from a downloaded report.
Remove pages with personal information before sending a document to a third party.
Trim a long manual down to the sections you actually need.
tips: Zoom in on thumbnails when pages look similar.
Your original file is never modified – keep it until you have checked the result.
To keep a few pages rather than delete many, Extract PDF Pages is quicker.

faq.q: Does deleting pages reduce file size?

extractpages.title: Extract Pages from PDF Online Free – Save Selected Pages | {brand}
extractpages.desc: Pick the pages you need and save them as a new PDF. Visual page selection, free, unlimited and private – nothing is uploaded.

guide.intro: Often you only need part of a document: one signed page, a single chapter or the pages that mention a project. Extract Pages lets you select those pages visually and save them as a new, smaller PDF without touching the original.

Share one chapter of a book or course pack with a study group.
Pull a single statement or invoice out of a combined monthly file.
Collect key slides from a long presentation exported as PDF.

For fixed ranges like 1-5, Split PDF with a page range is faster.
Extracted pages keep their original quality and selectable text.

splitbm.title: Split PDF by Bookmarks – Split into Chapters Online Free | {brand}
splitbm.desc: Split a PDF into separate files at each bookmark, such as chapters or sections. Files are named after the bookmarks. Free and private.

uses: Break an e-book or textbook into one file per chapter.
Split a technical manual so each team receives only its section.
Separate a combined board pack into individual agenda items.
tips: Open the PDF's bookmark panel first to check the outline exists and is accurate.
Choose top-level bookmarks for chapters, or deeper levels for sections.
No bookmarks? Use Split PDF by Text with a heading like "Chapter".

faq.q: What if my PDF has no bookmarks?
faq.a: Use Split PDF by text (for repeated headings) or Split PDF with page ranges instead.

splitsize.title: Split PDF by File Size – Make PDFs Under an MB Limit | {brand}
splitsize.desc: Split a large PDF into parts that each fit an email or upload size limit (for example 5 MB or 10 MB). Free, no upload, processed locally.

uses: Send a large scanned contract across several emails.
Upload a long application file to a portal with a per-file size limit.
Share big reports in chat apps that limit file sizes.
tips: Compress the PDF first – you may not need to split at all.
Set the limit slightly below the real cap to allow for email encoding overhead.
A single page larger than the limit is saved on its own; compress that part separately.

faq.a: A single page can be bigger than the limit (for example a high-resolution scan). It is saved as its own file; Compress PDF usually fixes it.

splittext.desc: Split a PDF wherever a word or phrase appears – such as "Invoice", "Statement" or "Chapter". Free, private, done in your browser.

uses: Split a batch of invoices into one PDF per invoice.
Separate payslips or letters generated in a single mail-merge file.
Break a report at each "Chapter" or "Section" heading.
tips: Use a word that appears only on the first page of each record, such as "Invoice No."
Matching is case-insensitive, so "INVOICE" and "invoice" both work.
The PDF needs a text layer; for scans, run OCR PDF first.

faq.q: Does it work with scanned PDFs?

uses: Print lecture slides 4 or 6 to a page as study handouts.
Create compact proof copies of a long document.
Save paper and toner when printing reference material.

Choose A4 or Letter to match your printer's paper.

Brand quotes, portfolios or reports with your company name.

Put the company name and "Confidential" on every page.
Stamp the print date on records and audit documents.
Label pages of an exhibit with the file name.

Keep headers short so they do not overlap page content.
For legal numbering across many files, use Bates Numbering.

faq.q: Can I use different text on the left, centre and right?

Track pages in audit, insurance or compliance submissions.

Improve OCR results by straightening pages first.

Stamp "Approved" or "Copy" on documents.
